entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aleksandrs Grīns was a Latvian writer, translator and army officer. He has written many novels and stories, many of them historic. Most of his works were banned in the Soviet Union from 1945 until 1991. He was awarded the Order of the Three Stars and Order of Viesturs.

entities.summary: Aleksandrs Grīns was a Latvian writer, translator and army officer. He has written many novels and stories, many of them historic. Most of his works were banned in the Soviet Union from 1945 until 1991. He was awarded the Order of the Three Stars and Order of Viesturs.
